expectation: Membrane ring on a subset of macrophages (also some DCs and endothelium), scattered or clustered single cells, often in stroma or perivascular zones. It should be a minority of cells and mostly overlap CD163+ cells.
observed: A: patchy yellow cell clusters and streaks in many ROIs, with one ROI holding big bright blobs. B and C: nearly empty, only sparse specks. D: clear membrane rings around nucleated cells. E: CD206 in cell-shaped clusters, partly on CD163 cells and partly in CD163-negative patches.
why: A distinct minority of cells show membrane-ring staining in clusters, and some of them sit on CD163 macrophages.
